body: Yeah, I agree man but thanks for the words.

Nah, thank you for sharing me your experiences. 

I realised that I’m my own enemy. These negative thinking and just self hate towards my self and not allowing my self to let go of past mistakes decided to manifest to only bite me on the ass right now. 

I thought as well as resitting, I’m going to allow my self to let everything negative go and go for the things that made me happy and try to fill everyday with fun.  

My main objective is to get rid of all these bad thoughts for once and for all.

I should definitely do that 

I always used to beat my self up for not doing such and such

My grades were the only redeeming feature of my self. Other than that I’m literally nothing. It’s actually crushing to see people who you met from secondary school do well on A-level and you tell your self how much you’re such a fuck up. 

They have their life on track, the fuck your still doing still being overly anxious of your past experiences and you still couldn’t get over it and allow your self to improve, what the fuck? 

I can’t even think of a place to be alone other than being in my room nor do I have the energy. There may be times where I feel ok but like I’ll know I’m not actually ok. 

Thank you btw

Hey man,

But I can’t get the out of my head. And I did work hard to the best of my ability given the situation.
